title: Rotational Kinematics Equation
text: The total angular displacement $$\theta$$ (in radians) can be found using the following equation: $$\omega_{f}**2=\omega_{i}**2+2\alpha\theta$$.

title: Convert Angular Displacement to Revolutions
text: Since $$2\pi$$ radians is one revolution, the number of revolutions is $$N=\frac{\theta}{2\pi}$$.
